examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix With Integer Entries
examples.worked_solution:
For a $2 \times 2$ matrix, the determinant is given by the formula

$$
|\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}|
$$

Using the formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot 6-2\cdot 5 \\  & =18-10 \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$
